minorFindingsFixed: The GA4 UI source-text guard assumed LF line endings and false-failed on a clean Windows CRLF checkout; the assertion now accepts LF or CRLF.
The spend-source destructive-safety guard expected superseded split delete calls; it now proves the existing campaign/source/platform-scoped transactional helper and rejects the old non-atomic calls.
The deployed validator captured traffic-backed consumers before their browser input reached a terminal state.
The authorized artifact validator initially selected unrelated GA4 Benchmark reports instead of requiring the campaign with both an active property and active GA4 Benchmarks.
The authorized validator used a timezone-sensitive database timestamp cutoff and falsely counted zero fresh delivered audits; it now compares provider response IDs with a pre-run baseline.
The read-only delivery inspector initially joined UUID and text snapshot identifiers without an explicit cast.
